title: 置换与复合次序
Permutations and composition
text: 置换是集合到自身的双射；运算是映射复合。本文统一先右后左：στ(x)=σ(τ(x))。
A permutation is a bijection of a set with itself; multiplication is composition. We consistently apply the right-hand factor first.
example: σ=(12)，τ=(23)：στ=(123)，而 τσ=(132)。跟踪一个点的去向即可核对次序。
For σ=(12), τ=(23), we have στ=(123) but τσ=(132). Track a single point to check the convention.

title: 不相交轮换分解
Disjoint cycle decomposition
text: 每个置换可分解为互不相交的轮换。除去轮换排列顺序及轮换的循环书写方式，这个分解唯一；固定点可省略。
Every permutation decomposes into disjoint cycles, uniquely up to the order of the cycles and cyclic rotation of each cycle. Fixed points may be omitted.
proof: 从任意未处理的点 a 出发，依次取 a,σ(a),σ²(a),…；有限性与双射性保证第一次重复必回到 a。
Start at an unused point and iterate σ. Finiteness and injectivity force the first repeated point to be the starting point.
得到一个轮换。删去其中各点，在剩余点中重复操作，直到所有点都被处理。
Remove this cycle and repeat on unused points until all points are covered.
每个点的整个迭代轨道由 σ 唯一决定，所以不相交轮换的点集及顺序都确定。
The orbit and cyclic order of each point are determined by σ, proving uniqueness.

title: 置换的阶
The order of a permutation
text: 若互不相交轮换的长度是 r₁,…,rₖ，则置换的阶是这些长度的最小公倍数。只有不相交时才能直接用此公式。
The order of a permutation is the least common multiple of the lengths of its disjoint cycles. The disjointness hypothesis matters.
proof: 不同轮换的支撑不相交，因而可以交换，且各自在自己的点集上独立运动。
Disjoint cycles commute and move independent sets of points.
σᵐ 固定所有点，当且仅当每个轮换都转过整数圈，即每个 rᵢ 都整除 m。
σᵐ is the identity exactly when each cycle completes whole turns, meaning every rᵢ divides m.
最小这样的正整数就是最小公倍数。
The least such positive integer is their least common multiple.
example: (123)(45) 的阶为 6；(123)(345) 不可直接取 lcm(3,3)，应先做不相交轮换分解。
(123)(45) has order 6. For (123)(345), first compute the disjoint cycle decomposition.

title: 对换生成所有置换
Transpositions generate Sₙ
text: 每个 r 轮换能写成 r−1 个对换的乘积，因此任意置换都能写成对换的乘积。对换分解本身不唯一。
An r-cycle is a product of r−1 transpositions. Thus every permutation is a product of transpositions, though the decomposition is not unique.
proof: 检查右边：a₁ 被最右对换送到 a₂，以后的对换不再动 a₂。
On the right, a₁ goes to a₂ under the rightmost transposition and stays there.
对 2≤j<r，aⱼ 先被送到 a₁，再由下一个对换送到 aⱼ₊₁；aᵣ 最后被送回 a₁。
For 2≤j<r, aⱼ goes first to a₁ and then to aⱼ₊₁. Finally aᵣ goes to a₁.
其余点不动，因此左右相同；再对每个不相交轮换应用这个恒等式。
All other points are fixed. Apply the identity to each disjoint cycle.

title: 奇偶性为何良定义
Why parity is well-defined
text: 令 Pσ 的第 j 列是 e_(σ(j))。置换矩阵满足 P_(στ)=PσPτ；每个对换的行列式为 −1。因此任意对换分解的长度具有相同奇偶性。
Let column j of Pσ be e_(σ(j)). Then P_(στ)=PσPτ, and each transposition has determinant −1. Thus all transposition decompositions have the same length parity.
proof: 矩阵作用于基向量：PσPτeⱼ=e_(σ(τ(j)))，所以置换复合对应矩阵乘法。
Apply the matrices to eⱼ to verify that composition corresponds to matrix multiplication.
对换交换单位矩阵的两列，故其行列式为 −1；行列式乘法性给出 sgn(σ)=(-1)ᵐ。
A transposition swaps two columns of the identity matrix, so its determinant is −1. A product of m transpositions has determinant (-1)ᵐ.
左边只依赖 σ，不依赖所选分解。因此 m 的奇偶性是置换本身的不变量。
The determinant depends only on σ, so parity is independent of the decomposition.
example: r 轮换的符号是 (−1)ʳ⁻¹。两个奇置换相乘为偶置换。
An r-cycle has sign (−1)ʳ⁻¹. A product of two odd permutations is even.

title: 交错群
The alternating group
text: 全部偶置换构成 Aₙ。对 n≥2，偶置换和奇置换各占一半。A₁ 是只有单位元的群，不能套用 n!/2。
The even permutations form Aₙ. For n≥2, exactly half the permutations are even. A₁ is trivial, so the formula n!/2 does not apply there.
proof: 单位元为偶置换；sgn(στ⁻¹)=sgn(σ)sgn(τ)⁻¹，所以偶置换满足子群判别。
The identity is even and signs multiply, so the subgroup criterion holds.
固定对换 t=(12)。σ↦tσ 把偶置换双射到奇置换，因为 t²=e 且符号反转。
Multiplication by t=(12) pairs every even permutation with a unique odd permutation.
所以 n! 个置换分成两个等大的部分。
The n! permutations split into two equally sized parts.
example: A₃={e,(123),(132)}≅C₃。A₄ 有 12 个元素，含 8 个三轮换、3 个双对换和单位元。
A₃ is cyclic of order 3. A₄ has 12 elements: eight 3-cycles, three double transpositions and the identity.

title: 纸牌魔术中的群论
Group theory in card magic
text: 三种纸牌魔术：从循环编码，到置换的阶，再到群作用。先观察效果；点击“＋”展开操作方法、演示与证明。
Three card tricks: cyclic encoding, permutation order and group actions. Start with the effect; expand “+” for instructions, demonstrations and proofs.

title: 五张牌读心
The five-card mind-reading trick
effect: 观众任选五张牌。助手藏起一张，按约定顺序摆出其余四张；你只看这四张，就能说出隐藏的牌。
A spectator chooses any five cards. An assistant hides one and arranges the other four; you identify the hidden card from those four alone.
connection: 循环群 ℤ/13ℤ · S₃ 的六种排列 · 抽屉原理
The cyclic group ℤ/13ℤ · Six permutations in S₃ · Pigeonhole principle

text: 使用不含大小王的 52 张牌，两位表演者事先约定规则。五张牌中必有两张同花色；任选一对，把点数 A,2,…,K 看成一个有向圆圈。
Use 52 distinct cards without jokers. Two performers agree on the code beforehand. Among five cards, choose two of the same suit; arrange ranks A,2,…,K on a directed circle.
这对牌的两个方向距离之和为 13，其中一个在 1 至 6 之间。把起点作为第一张明牌，终点藏起；因此第一张同时传递花色和起点。
The two directed distances sum to 13, so one is between 1 and 6. Show its starting card first and hide its endpoint. The first card conveys both suit and starting rank.
其余三张按点数从小到大排序；点数相同时约定 ♣ < ♦ < ♥ < ♠。把它们记为 L < M < H，并按下表编码步数。
Order the remaining three by rank, breaking ties by ♣ < ♦ < ♥ < ♠. Call them L < M < H and encode the distance using this table.
解码者读取第一张的花色，再按后三张的排列查出步数，沿点数圆圈前进。必须事先约定同一套排序；花色打破点数相同的情况。
The decoder reads the suit from the first card and advances by the distance encoded by the other three. Both performers must use the same ranking and suit tiebreaker.

title: 完整例子与群论联系
Worked example and the group connection

text: 观众给出 ♥Q、♥3、♣2、♦7、♠K。藏起 ♥3，先展示 ♥Q。其余三张满足 L=♣2、M=♦7、H=♠K；前进四步使用 MHL，所以依次展示 ♥Q、♦7、♠K、♣2。
Given ♥Q, ♥3, ♣2, ♦7, ♠K, hide ♥3 and show ♥Q first. The remaining cards satisfy L=♣2, M=♦7, H=♠K. Four steps are encoded by MHL, so display ♥Q, ♦7, ♠K, ♣2.
解码：后三张是 MHL，读出 4；Q → K → A → 2 → 3，花色仍是红桃。
Decode MHL as 4: Q → K → A → 2 → 3, keeping the heart suit.
点数移动使用循环群的加法；后三张利用 S₃ 的六个元素进行编码。这里不需要用到 S₃ 的群乘法，不能把整个原理都归结为置换复合。
Rank movement uses cyclic-group addition; the three cards use the six elements of S₃ as codewords. This encoding does not require the group multiplication of S₃.

Reference: University of Washington Math Hour · Fitch Cheney’s trick

title: 越洗越整齐
Shuffle back into order
effect: 八张牌按固定方法外洗三次，恢复原序；标准 52 张牌则需要八次完美外洗。
Eight cards return to their original order after three perfect out-shuffles; a standard 52-card deck requires eight.
connection: 置换复合 · 不相交轮换 · 元素的阶
Permutation composition · Disjoint cycles · Element order

title: 操作方法与八张牌演示
Procedure and an eight-card demonstration

text: 将牌堆等分，保持每半副的内部顺序。从原上半副取第一张，再从原下半副取第一张，严格交替合并。原顶牌和底牌始终不动：这叫完美外洗。
Split the deck equally, preserving each half’s order. Interleave strictly, starting with the original top half. The original top and bottom cards remain at the ends: a perfect out-shuffle.
课堂上用标为 1 至 8 的八张牌，逐张摆放即可，无需洗牌手法。下面的按钮执行同一个置换；每张牌的编号保持不变。
In class, use eight cards labelled 1 to 8 and interleave them on a table. No sleight of hand is needed. The button below applies the same permutation; card labels stay fixed.

title: 为什么三次、八次会复原？
Why three shuffles, or eight?

text: 八张牌的位置按 1 至 8 编号。一次外洗把原位置 2 送到 3、3 送到 5、5 送回 2；另一条轨道是 4 → 7 → 6 → 4。位置 1、8 固定。
Number positions 1 to 8. One out-shuffle sends 2 → 3 → 5 → 2 and 4 → 7 → 6 → 4, fixing positions 1 and 8.
对 52 张牌改用位置 0,…,51。外洗固定 51，在其余位置上由下面的模运算描述。
For 52 cards use positions 0,…,51. The out-shuffle fixes 51 and acts on the other positions by:
2⁸≡1 (mod 51)，而 2、2²、2⁴ 均不等于 1 (mod 51)，所以模 51 下 2 的乘法阶恰为 8。因此八次复原，而且此前不会整副复原。普通随意洗牌不满足这个结论。

Since 2⁸≡1 (mod 51), while 2, 2² and 2⁴ are not 1 modulo 51, the multiplicative order is exactly 8. Thus eight out-shuffles restore the whole deck, and no smaller positive number does. Arbitrary shuffles do not have this property.

label: 参考：Harvey Mudd College · Perfect Shuffles
Reference: Harvey Mudd College · Perfect Shuffles

title: 把一张牌送到指定位置
Send a card to a chosen position
effect: 先把选中的牌放到牌堆顶端。观众指定第 1 至 52 张中的一个位置；按计算出的内洗、外洗顺序，把它准确送到那里。
Place the chosen card on top. The spectator names a position from 1 to 52; a calculated sequence of in- and out-shuffles sends it there.
connection: 群作用 · 置换复合的次序 · 二进制路径
Group actions · Order of composition · A binary path

title: 输入目标位置，查看洗牌路线
Choose a position and inspect the route

text: 外洗 O 从原上半副开始交错；内洗 I 从原下半副开始交错。两者都要求等分并严格交替。输入的是从 1 开始数的第几张；计算时减 1，改用位置 0,…,51。

Out-shuffle O interleaves starting with the original top half; in-shuffle I starts with the bottom half. Both split equally and alternate strictly. Enter a one-based position; subtract 1 to calculate with indices 0,…,51.
把目标索引写成二进制，从左向右读。0 对应外洗 O，1 对应内洗 I。目标为第 1 张时无需洗牌。
Read the target index in binary from left to right: 0 means O and 1 means I. Reaching position 1 requires no shuffle.

title: 为什么有效？为什么顺序重要？
Why does it work, and why does order matter?

text: 当被追踪的牌位于前半副，即索引 k<26 时，外洗和内洗分别把它送到 2k 和 2k+1。
While the tracked card lies in the top half, with index k<26, O sends it to 2k and I to 2k+1.
从 0 开始逐位读二进制，正是在重复“乘 2，再加下一位”。目标索引最多 51，因此每一步操作前的前缀最多 25，始终符合上述公式的范围。
Reading binary digits repeats “multiply by 2 and add the next digit”, starting from 0. The target is at most 51, so every prefix before an operation is at most 25, keeping the formulas valid.
例：第七张对应索引 6=(110)₂。按时间顺序做 I、I、O，轨迹为 0→1→3→6；按本课先右后左的乘法约定，复合写成 OI²。
Position 7 has index 6=(110)₂. Execute I, I, O in time order: 0→1→3→6. Under our right-to-left composition convention, this is OI².
整副牌上的 I、O 都是 S₅₂ 的置换。由它们生成的子群作用在 52 个位置上；操作顺序不同，结果可以不同。
On the whole deck, I and O are permutations in S₅₂. Their generated subgroup acts on the 52 positions, and changing the order can change the result.

question: (1234)(567) 的阶是多少？
What is the order of (1234)(567)?
reason: 两个轮换不相交，阶为 lcm(4,3)=12。
The disjoint cycles have lengths 4 and 3, giving lcm 12.

question: (12345) 是奇置换还是偶置换？
Is (12345) odd or even?
reason: 5 轮换可写为 4 个对换，符号为 +1。
A 5-cycle is a product of four transpositions and has sign +1.

question: A₄ 中有多少个三轮换？
How many 3-cycles are in A₄?
reason: 选 3 个点有 4 种，每组有两个三轮换，共 8 个。
Choose three points in four ways; each choice gives two cycles.

question: 求 σ=(123)(345) 的不相交轮换分解、阶和奇偶性。
Find the disjoint cycle form, order and parity of σ=(123)(345).
reason: Point tracking gives σ=(12345), of order 5 and sign +1.
